name: Apple
summary:
Apple’s website favicon is separate from the 180×180 apple-touch icon any site can publish for iOS, and separate from the Apple Music host. This page is the files apple.com itself serves.

Checked 12 November 2026 against apple.com. HTML came from https://www.apple.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.apple.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 22382 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 64×64.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.apple.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 152×152 png.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: png-152x152-01.png at 152×152 (png, 4506 bytes) from https://www.apple.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
